title: 恐龙蛋里面是什么
subtitle: 壳太厚就出不来了
character: wearing a peach t-shirt, sand coloured shorts and white sneakers, short black hair
style: children's picture book illustration, soft transparent watercolour with clean wet washes, warm sand, pale peach and soft grey green

pages.zh:
柜子里放着几个蛋，
灰灰的，
看上去像石头。
爸爸说，
里面本来有小恐龙。
pages.scene: Waist-up view of the little boy leaning close to a museum case of round fossil eggs, his face large in the frame and turned towards the viewer, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, curious.

pages.zh:
恐龙蛋有多大呢？
最大的
和一个足球差不多。
可再大的恐龙，
蛋也大不到哪里去。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one chicken egg shape and one football-sized egg shape side by side on a cream background, the big one clearly larger. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
蛋要是太大，
壳就得很厚。
壳太厚，
里面的小恐龙
就啄不破，出不来了。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: two eggs cut open side by side on a cream background, one with a thin shell and one with a very thick shell. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
下蛋以前，
它先在地上挖一个坑，
铺上叶子，
再把蛋一个一个
摆进去。
pages.scene: One dinosaur crouching over a shallow nest pit lined with leaves on a cream background, placing eggs into it. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
蛋不是乱放的。
有的绕成一圈一圈，
中间空着。
这样每一个蛋
都晒得到太阳。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one round nest seen from above on a cream background with eggs arranged in a ring around an empty middle. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
有的恐龙
会趴在窝边上，
用身体和前肢
把蛋轻轻盖住，
不让它们变凉。
pages.scene: One feathered dinosaur sitting over a nest with its arms spread across the eggs on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
蛋壳上有很多小孔，
小到看不见。
空气从小孔钻进去，
里面的小恐龙
才能呼吸。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: one piece of eggshell shown greatly magnified on a cream background with many tiny holes through it and small arrows passing inward. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
时候到了，
小恐龙用鼻子上的小尖
把壳顶开一道缝，
再一点一点
钻出来。
pages.scene: One baby dinosaur pushing its head out through a crack in an egg on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
刚出来的小恐龙
很小，腿也软，
站都站不稳。
它们挤在一起，
互相靠着取暖。
pages.scene: Three newly hatched baby dinosaurs huddled together in a nest on a cream background. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
爸爸妈妈
要一趟一趟
把吃的带回来。
窝里全是张着嘴
等着吃的小家伙。
pages.scene: One adult dinosaur standing over a nest on a cream background, three small scaly hatchlings with beaked snouts and stubby tails stretching up towards it with their beaks open wide.

pages.zh:
小恐龙长得很快。
几年工夫，
就从和猫一样大，
长到比一辆车
还要大。
pages.scene: A simple clear diagram, drawn flat and plain: four dinosaur silhouettes in a row on a cream background, each much taller than the one before, with a rising line drawn over their heads. Nothing else in the picture.

pages.zh:
我趴在玻璃前面
看那几个蛋。
它们还是圆圆的，
只是里面
已经空了。
pages.scene: Close on the little boy resting his chin on the edge of the museum case, his face large in the frame and turned towards the viewer, quiet and thoughtful, both eyes clearly drawn with white, a dark round iris and a small bright highlight, the round fossil eggs just behind the glass beside him.
